when.condition: @(bool.TryParse("{{content-safety-enabled}}", out var contentSafetyEnabled) && contentSafetyEnabled && !string.IsNullOrEmpty("{{content-safety-endpoint}}") && context.Request != null && context.Request.Method == "POST" && (context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path.Contains("/chat/completions") || context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path.Contains("/responses") || context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path.Contains("/completions")))

@{ var response = (IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("content-safety-request", null); if (response == null || response.Body == null) { return false; } var payload = response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); return payload.SelectTokens("$.categoriesAnalysis[*].severity").Any(token => (int)token >= 4); }

return-response.set-body: @{ var response = (IResponse)context.Variables["content-safety-request"]; var payload = response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", "PromptBlocked"), new JProperty("message", "The request was blocked by Azure Content Safety before model invocation."), new JProperty("categories", payload["categoriesAnalysis"])))).ToString(); }

set-variable.name: content-safety-response-text
set-variable.value: @{ return context.Response == null || context.Response.Body == null ? string.Empty : context.Response.Body.As<string>(preserveContent: true); }

when.condition: @{ var response = (IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("content-safety-response", null); if (response == null || response.Body == null) { return false; } var payload = response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); return payload.SelectTokens("$.categoriesAnalysis[*].severity").Any(token => (int)token >= 4); }

return-response.set-body: @{ var response = (IResponse)context.Variables["content-safety-response"]; var payload = response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", "ResponseBlocked"), new JProperty("message", "The model response was blocked by Azure Content Safety."), new JProperty("categories", payload["categoriesAnalysis"])))).ToString(); }
